scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/observability build && bun run --cwd packages/channel-core build && bun run --cwd packages/llm-router build && bun run --cwd packages/verticals build && bun run --cwd packages/storage build && bun run --cwd packages/channel-telegram build && bun run --cwd packages/channel-web build && bun run --cwd packages/channel-whatsapp build && bun run --cwd packages/channel-facebook build && bun run --cwd packages/channel-vk build && bun run --cwd packages/channel-max build && bun run --cwd packages/kb build && bun run --cwd packages/conversation-engine build && bun run --cwd packages/sales build
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d && docker compose exec -T postgres bash -c 'until pg_isready -U lead -d lead_engine >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done' && echo 'postgres ready @ localhost:5434'
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && docker compose exec -T postgres bash -c 'until pg_isready -U lead -d lead_engine >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done' && DATABASE_URL=postgres://lead:lead@localhost:5434/lead_engine bun run apps/api/scripts/reset-and-migrate.ts
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U lead lead_engine
